chunks: They have made their oaths a shield in order to obstruct others from the way of God. It is certainly evil what they do.
ai.seo_question: How did the hypocrites use their oaths to obstruct people from the way of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights how the hypocrites (Munafiqun) weaponized their oaths as a 'shield' (junnah) to create a facade of piety while actively obstructing others from the divine path. This duality underscores the concept of *taqiyya* in reverse—using religious commitment as a tool for deception rather than protection—and serves as a warning against superficial adherence to faith. The conclusion emphasizes that their internal corruption ultimately manifested in their external actions, leading to their spiritual ruin.
